analysis.one_line_summary: A creator demonstrates how to achieve a bouncy 90s salon blowout using the viral baby pink Wavytalk thermal brush.
analysis.full_description: The ad opens with a finished blowout result tease as the creator fluffs her hair, framed by the caption 'all i've been seeing on my fyp is this baby pink thermal brush'. She flashes the pink thermal brush to the camera, then cuts to her flat, unstyled hair. She preps with heat protectant and sections her hair with a claw clip. Step-by-step, she curls and rolls sections around the thermal brush, demonstrating the technique on both sides and bangs. She finishes by shaking out bouncy, glossy curls and showing the back of her hair before posing next to the product.
